core_meaning.primary_meaning: Afeef is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Chaste, virtuous, modest”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Afeef corresponds to the Arabic form عفيف (Arabic root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f); عَفِيف (ʿafīf)). Its core sense is chaste, virtuous; modest. Afeef is Arabic عَفِيف (ʿafīf) 'Chaste, virtuous, modest', the faʿīl-pattern adjective of chastity built on the root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f). Afeef is a variant romanization of Afif.

etymology.morphology: Faʿīl-pattern stative adjective built on the root ع ف ف.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع ف ف (ʿ-f-f)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عفيف is an established Arabic lexical item — the faʿīl-pattern adjective of the root ع ف ف — and Afeef is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.
